# Infralicious

> Small, honest software for teams. TrueTime for Jira: Forge-native timesheets.

## Products

- [TrueTime for Jira](https://infralicious.com/truetime/): Forge-native timesheets for Jira. One-click timers, weekly timesheets, approvals, Tempo CSV import. Free for up to 10 users, $2.99 per user per month above that. Currently in beta.

## Documentation

- [TrueTime User Guide](https://infralicious.com/truetime/user-guide.html): Log time, approvals, teams, admin settings.
- [Migrate from Tempo](https://infralicious.com/truetime/migration.html): Move Tempo history to TrueTime with a CSV export.
- [TrueTime API](https://infralicious.com/truetime/api.html): Create time entries with the Jira REST API.
- [TrueTime Support](https://infralicious.com/truetime/support.html): How to get help.
